pages.title: A kindness left in the metal.
pages.body: In a devastated machine world, repairs given freely left something behind. That grace gathered in discarded parts. You are what answered.
steps: Carry the work forward
Move through the ruins, gather relics and choose which broken machines receive your care.
Begin with a choice
Choose a frame and Blessing. Your weapons can take a different direction as the pilgrimage unfolds.
pages.note: The first chapter begins at the Collapsed Workshop.

pages.title: Move; the relics answer.
pages.body: Weapons attack automatically. Your job is to find room, collect what falls and put each relic where its attack can reach.
steps: Keep an exit open
Move around the machinery. Leave marked danger areas before the attack lands.
Read the threat
Hounds and Brutes show their charge direction. A Choir Drone supports nearby machines.
pages.note: Move with your chosen keys, arrow keys or the left stick.

pages.title: Repair when it helps.
pages.body: Stand near a broken Workshop machine to work on it. Read its reward, watch the approaching enemies and leave whenever you need room.
steps: Choose the reward
The Sorter grants Scrap, the Pump restores structure and the Bell staggers enemies.
Keep moving when hurt
Repair kits also drop in the field. Shops sell relics; repairs never occupy their offer slots.
pages.note: Repairs are optional. Survive and defeat the boss to advance.

pages.title: Make a relic your own.
pages.body: Between waves, spend Scrap on weapons and Gifts. Relic Shards buy catalysts. A Blessing favours a direction while leaving room to experiment.
steps: Combine, then transform
Combine matching weapon ranks. A Rank III relic and its named catalyst can unlock an Evolution in the ledger.
Make room deliberately
Carry four active weapons and one reserve. Gifts have separate slots. Inspect an offer before buying.
pages.note: The Evolution Ledger shows recipes and missing ingredients.

pages.title: Carry it down the road.
pages.body: Defeat the Foreman to leave the Workshop. Choose Brass Choir or Rootworks, then follow one more road to the final site of this expedition.
steps: Inspect before travelling
The map explains a destination. Select it to inspect, then confirm separately to travel.
Return when you are ready
Save from Pause or between waves. Continue on the title restores the expedition you left.
pages.note: Memories open new choices. They do not buy permanent damage.
